_about: The forecast's inputs. The Model page (model/model.js) reads this file; edit here only. Probabilities are 0-1.

P0.note: elected before the Nov 13 cutoff (23:59 ET Nov 12); no sitting scheduled

A.note: the scheduled vote is held by 23:59 ET Nov 17

B.note: someone is elected, given the vote is held

C.note: elected by 23:59 ET Nov 30, given not by Nov 17

D.note: elected by 23:59 ET Dec 31, given not by Nov 30
